title: Residual: graphs with G and complement of diameter at most 2, no pure degree class and no unique-copy gluing pair
statement_en: Every graph G on at least 3 vertices such that G and its complement are connected, every pair of vertices has distance at most 2 in G and in its complement, G has no pure degree class (as in pure_degree_class) and no unique-copy factorizing pair (as in unique_copy_gluing) is reconstructible. Open.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => G.Connected ∧ Gᶜ.Connected ∧ (∀ u v : Fin n, G.edist u v ≤ 2 ∧ Gᶜ.edist u v ≤ 2) ∧ ¬ (∃ u : Fin n, ∀ x y x' y' : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → (G.neighborSet x').ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → x ≠ y → x' ≠ y' → Nonempty (G.induce ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x', y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) → (G.Adj x y ↔ G.Adj x' y')) ∧ ¬ (∃ u v : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ (∀ T : Finset (Fin n), Nonempty (G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce (T : Set (Fin n))) → (T : Set (Fin n)) = {u, v}ᶜ) ∧ ∀ g : G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∃ h : G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (∀ x : ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj v (h x).1 ↔ G.Adj v x.1) ∧ (∀ x : ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj u (g (h x)).1 ↔ G.Adj u x.1)))
